description: Local-first search, resume, handoff, usage tracking, and bulk session management for AI coding sessions.
notes: This package follows the customized nonlog/Recall fork merged through upstream Recall 0.6.5.
TUI source branding keeps distinct colors/icons with Unicode fallbacks.
Optional Herdr Agent Icons Max logos: configure an icon-capable terminal font and set RECALL_ICON_STYLE=herdr (Windows Terminal: start a new session after setting the user environment variable).
The user's patched Herdr Agent Icons Max font maps Droid to U+E1BB; RECALL_ICON_STYLE=herdr uses that exact glyph, while plain mode uses the text fallback. A matching patched font is required.
Droid local Trash/permanent delete validates UUID and session_start.id, and includes only the selected session's settings and backup files.
Droid deletion affects local Factory files only, not Factory cloud-synced copies (cloudSessionSync is enabled by default).
Delete moves selected/current sessions to Recall trash; Ctrl+D permanently deletes them. Bulk selection uses Insert, Ctrl+Space, or Space while the search box is empty.

Native-aware deletion now covers every source currently indexed on LOG: stale paths are re-resolved only inside trusted stores; Copilot Chat/CLI and Grok use source-specific file/directory rules; ZCode Trash uses a verified SQLite backup before native row deletion.
Scoop persists both trash and data across upgrades; recall.db lives under the persisted data directory on Windows.
Codex native titles follow state_5.sqlite plus the latest session_index.jsonl rename.
Claude Code and Pi titles follow native/generated metadata (custom-title/ai-title and session_info.name) before prompt fallback.
Skill Audit recognizes shared, Pi, Gemini, OpenCode, and Windows backslash skill paths.
The bottom shortcut bar follows upstream: Ctrl+S runs Sync and Ctrl+P opens Settings.
The separate www/rx dependency provides rx, rxc, rxx, rxo, rxp, rxd, and rxk; it updates independently from Recall.
